name: Tama Home Co., Ltd.
summary: Tama Home Co., Ltd. provides residential construction, real estate, financial, and energy services primarily in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Housing Business, Real Estate Business, Financial Business, and Energy Business. The Housing Business segment provides construction contracts for custom-built homes and renovation contracts, as well as introductions to ancillary work, such as exterior construction; and pre-cut CAD input and drawing creation design support services.
